title: UNTYING THE MEEREENESE KNOT
narrative: For fifteen real-world years, Daenerys sat on an ebony bench in Meereen debating olive oil tariffs, pit fighters, and harpy conspiracies. No more. Drogon descends like a falling star upon Slaver's Bay. Barristan Selmy draws his blade, the Iron Fleet arrives, and Daenerys orders Drogon to incinerate the Yunkish trebuchets. Four hundred pages of bureaucratic Essos stalling vaporize into smoke. The dragons turn west.

options.text: Confront Young Griff (Aegon VI) outside King's Landing — demand proof of his Targaryen blood.
Assault the Red Keep directly with dragonfire before Cersei can detonate wildfire.
Bypass the capital entirely and fly directly North to the Wall.
Victarion Greyjoy: Crash the Iron Fleet into Slaver's Bay with your smoking black arm.
Ser Barristan Selmy: Lead the city garrison through the bronze gates to break the Yunkish lines.
Daenerys kind of forgets: Dany flies through a bunny cloud and forgets the ironborn fleet below.
options.introducesPlotHole: Severe Tactical Amnesia Due to Fluffy Clouds
